think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range/values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob has one or more sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature or using an automatic/default algorithm), rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record those special values; otherwise classify as not special.
